weakspot_context:
Srv\_Debounce

Srv\_Debounce

Srv\_Debounce debounces a toggling boolean input signal and returns the debounced state of the signal as boolean value.  
This function is used to debounce a digital input signal by separate high to low and low to high debounce times

| Hint |
| --- |
| Each function call calculates a new debounce timer value and thus result might be wrong if called not exactly once per process call.  This class does not contain sequence numbers for the class methods.  The out value has to be connected to a variable to compute the class.  if the output is used in multiple places, there is a risk that the class output might be calculated twice. To avoid this use a process local variable at the output of the class(incase output is used in multiple places). |

 

Example Implementation:

Methods:

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| init | Sets the internal state of Boolean function |
| out | Returns the debounced input value |

Parameter:

| Parameter | Description | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dt | Dt sample time  Attention:  Dt element and Dt port must have the same conversion formula.  Hint:  If using Per\_Dur as implementation for Dt element in BDE, simulation does not work for time dependent elements. Therefore it is recommended to use Time\_Dt. | sint32 Time\_Dt |
| param | Instance of the structure which holds the timing parameters for the debounce element | Srv\_DebounceParam\_t |
| return | The debounced value of the input signal. | uint8 ident (logical signal is returned) |
| timer | timer for low to high transition | sint32 Time\_Dt |
| x | Input signal | uint8 ident (logical signal is expected at the input) |
| x/old | Internal state | uint8 Ident(logical signal) |

| Related information | |
| --- | --- |
| Srv\_DebounceParam\_t  SRV: SrvX\_Debounce  Doors link (SRV) : SrvX\_Debounce | |
